    Test instrument balance across pre-treatment outcomes

    test_instrument_balance.Rd

    Stratifies units into quantile groups of each instrument value and tests whether mean pre-treatment outcomes differ across groups via one-way ANOVA. Significant differences suggest the instrument correlates with baseline outcomes, raising exclusion concerns.

    test_instrument_balance(
  dt,
  outcomes,
  instruments,
  id_col = "customer_id",
  time_col = "wID",
  treatment = "budgetdummy",
  n_quantiles = 4L,
  alpha = 0.05,
  verbose = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    dt

    data.table. Panel data in long format.

    outcomes

    Character vector. Outcome column names.

    instruments

    Character vector. Instrument column names.

    id_col

    Character. Unit identifier. Default "customer_id".

    time_col

    Character. Time identifier. Default "wID".

    treatment

    Character. Treatment column. Default "budgetdummy".

    n_quantiles

    Integer. Number of quantile groups. Default 4.

    alpha

    Numeric. Significance level. Default 0.05.

    verbose

    Logical. Print results. Default TRUE.

    Value

    A data.frame with columns outcome, instrument, f_stat, p_value, significant, conclusion.
